title: Polynomial unary output is polynomial-time
statement: For every $C,d\in\mathbb{N}$, the function sending a bit string $x$ to the word consisting of $C(|x|+1)^d$ copies of $1$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: For all $C, d \in \mathbb{N}$, the map sending a bit string $x$ to the word $1^{C(|x|+1)^d}$ of $C(|x|+1)^d$ ones is polynomial-time computable, i.e.\ some finite binary Turing machine computes it within $K(n+1)^k$ steps on every input of length $n$, for some constants $K, k \in \mathbb{N}$.
